style: Moonlit symbolic article covers: deep navy, graphite, porcelain and restrained blue/teal/gold accents; no text or logos. Opaque covers are a user-requested exception to the transparent feature-icon style.
commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a complete original horizontal article-cover illustration and social-preview image for a premium dark technical journal. Wide 1.905:1 composition, target 1200 by 630, full bleed, entirely without text. Sophisticated, precise, quiet moonlit engineering art: deep midnight navy background, sculptural graphite and pale porcelain objects with fine technical etched detail, restrained icy blue and desaturated teal highlights, occasional warm moonlight accent. Main readable silhouette and all important symbols within central 80% width and 70% height so wide responsive crops remain meaningful. Rich but restrained depth, fine material realism, no excessive glow, no stock-photo feel, no busy HUD.
